title: Increase spacing between top-level menus to match that of in-window menus
line: Global Menu items in the panel are now spaced like the menu bar inside windows.
explanation: The Global Menu's buttons took their horizontal padding only from the Plasma theme's menubaritem SVG, whose margin hints are 8 px. Breeze draws in-window menu bar items with 10 px on each side (MenuBarItem_MarginWidth), so the panel's menu looked a bit cramped next to the same menu inside a window. The change adds half of Kirigami's small spacing (2 px) to the left and right padding, so the items now line up with Breeze's in-window menu bar.

commits.message:
applets/appmenu: match the padding of in-window menu bars

Global Menu items used only the theme's menubaritem margins, which left
them 2 pixels narrower on each side than the items of an in-window menu
bar drawn by Breeze. Add half a small spacing to the horizontal padding.

BUG: 481631

patches.diff:
From 5d61b3f297f44f3d3ff19bbb849e5a85aa84dd51 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:51:54 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/appmenu: match the padding of in-window menu bars

Global Menu items used only the theme's menubaritem margins, which left
them 2 pixels narrower on each side than the items of an in-window menu
bar drawn by Breeze. Add half a small spacing to the horizontal padding.

BUG: 481631
---
 applets/appmenu/qml/MenuDelegate.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/appmenu/qml/MenuDelegate.qml b/applets/appmenu/qml/MenuDelegate.qml
index 9bcbaf6052..4099e9a634 100644
--- a/applets/appmenu/qml/MenuDelegate.qml
+++ b/applets/appmenu/qml/MenuDelegate.qml
@@ -55,8 +55,8 @@ AbstractButton {
     Kirigami.MnemonicData.label: text
 
     topPadding: rest.margins.top
-    leftPadding: rest.margins.left
-    rightPadding: rest.margins.right
+    leftPadding: rest.margins.left + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 2
+    rightPadding: rest.margins.right + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 2
     bottomPadding: rest.margins.bottom
 
     Accessible.description: i18nc("@info:usagetip", "Open a menu")
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Global Menu in the panel (Dolphin), Edit hovered: items 37 px apart from File to Edit, tighter than the in-window menu bar (41 px)
Same menu with the fix, View open: items 41 px apart, the same as Dolphin's own menu bar

review.text: Increases Global Menu item horizontal padding by `Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing / 2` on each side in `MenuDelegate.qml`, matching Breeze's in-window `QMenuBar` item spacing (41 px advance vs 37 px before) while keeping the Plasma theme's `menubaritem` margins as the base. The change is symmetric/RTL-safe, preserves vertical padding and hover/pressed highlight geometry, and directly follows the maintainer direction from the bug report.
